shots.content: Inside a living room, a rectangular coffee table stands between a bookcase and the doorway. A two-seat sofa runs along one long side, facing an armchair near the bookcase end. A woman in a white shirt sits at the bookcase-side sofa seat and asks about the dinner invitation, a woman in a blue shirt sits at the doorway-side sofa seat, and a man in a yellow shirt sits at the bookcase-side armchair.
shots.viewpoint: Wide establishing shot from just beside the doorway end, looking along the coffee table toward the bookcase, with both sofa seats and the bookcase-side armchair and the bookcase in frame.

shots.content: A woman in a white shirt and a woman in a blue shirt exchange seats, whereupon the latter asks about the missing refreshments and the former answers.
shots.viewpoint: Medium two-shot from the coffee-table side, centered on the two sofa seats.

shots.content: A woman in a white shirt explains the dinner plan.
shots.viewpoint: Top-down wide shot directly above the coffee table.
